title: Fadeno Model Comparison
description: A judge's structured judgment of one shadow pair. Written against BLINDED arms (arm_a / arm_b); the kernel unblinds when it renders the ModelComparison artifact, so a judgment can never see which arm was the primary. Deterministic measurements are supplied to the judge and are never restated here — the kernel already knows them, and a judge's recollection of a number is not evidence.

verdict.description: prefer_* names an arm as better AS SHIPPED. `graft` means neither arm should be taken whole — the honest answer for both pairs judged so far — and requires a non-empty graft_plan. `tie` means genuinely equivalent; `inconclusive` means the evidence does not support a call, which is a valid outcome and must not be avoided by guessing.

graft_plan.description: Required when verdict is `graft`, forbidden otherwise. Prose instructions a person acts on, not hunks to apply blindly.

from_arm.description: Blinded arm label. The kernel translates to primary/challenger at render time.

why.description: The reason this material wins. Repo convention counts here: what separated the first two pairs was convention adherence, not general code quality.

paths.description: Advisory. Where the material lives, when known.

criteria.description: Per-criterion assessment. Qualitative by design: the deterministic signals are measured by the kernel, and asking a judge to re-derive them invites a confident wrong number.

shared_blind_spots.description: Defects present in BOTH arms. Required, and may be empty only after actually looking — agreement between two arms is not evidence they are right. Pair 89536181's arms both matched a Codex agent on model and effort while neither checked the role slot, and both arms' tests used a fixture where the case could not arise.

why_invisible.description: What made this survive both arms — usually a fixture or config both assumed.

confound_notes.description: Optional. The kernel stamps the confounds it can prove from the ledger; this is only for one a judge observed that the ledger cannot see.

then.description: A graft verdict that names nothing is unactionable, and reads in a scorecard exactly like a considered one.

else.description: A plan under any other verdict is a judge contradicting itself; accepting either half quietly is how a wrong answer looks right.
